title: In the Footsteps of a Killer
summary: They reopen an old case from 8 years ago where a journalist was murdered. A new witness emerges who exonerates the person who was originally convicted of the murder (who died in prison).
method: The killer faked the crime scene as the office and told his wife to say in the voicemail she was still at the office. She was shot at home, buried in cement, and the victim was framed.
